text: Program Description 1. Period of Study After formal admission, students will have a full-time study for 4 years in China University of Political Science and Law (CUPL). 2. Specialized required courses An Introduction To Sociology Higher Mathematics 1 Higher Mathematics 2 Sociological Theories Abrad 1 Social Psychology Survey Of Social Work Sociological Theories Abroad 2 Chinese Society Social Research Methods Theories Of Western Contemporary Sociology Social Anthropology English For Sociology Statistical Software Applications Political Sociology Ecnomic Sociology Development Sociology Social Stratification And Flows Public required courses Fundamentals of Computer Applications An Introduction to Chinese Civilization An Introduction to Western Civilization Chinese-1 Chinses-2 General Introduction to China 3. Tuition and Application Fee of the Preparatory Courses Tuition is 20,000 RMB per year; application fee is 660 RMB. Those whose Chinese proficiency is under HSK level 5, without receiving preparatory courses and intend to directly enter bachelor's degree study need to pay the application service fee 10,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.). 4. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves. 5. Scholarship Foreign students will obtain "the scholarship for freshmen", once they are admitted by our university as freshmen.
